description: Capability for image editor pop-out windows (spec.md subtask 12), each labeled "image-editor-<id>" by lib/imageEditorWindow.ts. default.json's/sticky.json's own capabilities only cover the "main"/"sticky-*" windows, so this window needs its own grant: fs:allow-read-file to read back the temp image file lib/imageEditorWindow.ts wrote under $APPDATA/image-editor/, fs:allow-remove so ImageEditor.tsx can delete that temp file on close, plus close (core:window:default alone is read-only) for ImageEditor.tsx's Close button.
